visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long wavy brown hair appears in a close-up, wearing a blue and white checkered top and a pearl necklace. She holds a pink TYMO hair styling tool towards the camera. The background is a brightly lit indoor bedroom with soft beige walls. (2) The scene shifts to the woman sitting on a bed with a patterned duvet, wearing a floral strap dress. She gestures with her hands while speaking directly to the camera. (3) A brief outdoor shot follows, showing the woman inside a car with a Hello Kitty sticker on her cheek, sunlight illuminating her face. (4) Back indoors, she holds up a pink TYMO automatic curler, pointing at the brand logo. She then shows a smartphone screen displaying a stopwatch timer starting from zero. (5) She demonstrates the curling process by sectioning her hair and placing it into the rotating mechanism of the device. (6) She holds a different pink tool, a hair waver, and demonstrates its use on her hair. (7) The final sequence shows her wearing a blue checkered set and white sunglasses, posing to show off her completed wavy hairstyle in a well-lit indoor space and outdoors.
